misconceptions.description: Assuming every performance problem should be solved with training
misconceptions.trigger: learner proposes instruction before diagnosing environmental or motivational causes
misconceptions.feedback: A good analysis phase checks whether the gap is really a knowledge or skill problem. If the root cause is tools, incentives, or workflow, training may not help.

misconceptions.description: Treating objectives as a formality written after the course content exists
misconceptions.trigger: learner says objectives can be added at the end without changing design decisions
misconceptions.feedback: Objectives should shape the design from the beginning. They align assessment, activities, and content with the target performance.

misconceptions.description: Reducing learner analysis to age, role, or job title only
misconceptions.trigger: learner ignores prior knowledge, motivation, or constraints in analysis
misconceptions.feedback: Learner analysis is broader than demographics. It includes prior knowledge, language needs, motivation, context, access constraints, and likely barriers to learning.
